lawyer_required_text: Your case involves complex legal issues. We strongly recommend consulting a licensed immigration attorney.

install.bannerDescription: Add to home screen for quick access to guides and checklists

login_desc: Access your saved cases and personalized guides
register_desc: Save your questionnaire and track visa progress
auth_callback_error: Sign-in link expired or invalid. Try logging in again.
supabase_not_configured: Auth is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, then restart the app.
register_success_confirm_email: Account created! Check your email and click the confirmation link before logging in.
register_email_exists: An account with this email already exists. Try logging in instead.
register_db_error: Server database error during signup. An admin must apply supabase/fix_signup.sql in the Supabase SQL Editor.
update_password_desc: Choose a new password for your account
update_password_error: Could not update password. Try again.
update_password_too_short: Password must be at least 6 characters.
landing_hero_title: Your step-by-step guide to US visas
landing_hero_desc: Answer a questionnaire, get a personalized visa recommendation, and follow a clear checklist of steps and documents.
landing_feature1_desc: Tell us about your citizenship, goals, work, health, and history — we match you to the right visa path.
landing_feature2_desc: Step-by-step instructions with official forms, timelines, and progress tracking.
landing_feature3_desc: Editors update rules and steps. Banners alert you to recent changes.
landing_feature4_desc: Know exactly what to prepare. Export your checklist as PDF.
landing_feature5_desc: Learn from anonymized stories of people who navigated complex visa paths, RFEs, denials, and appeals.
archive_desc: Real anonymized journeys — complex cases, rights advocacy, denials, and approvals. Open to everyone, no login required.
archive_search_placeholder: Search by title, tag, or keyword...
archive_anonymized_notice: Stories are anonymized composites for educational purposes. Names and details are changed to protect privacy. They do not constitute legal advice.
admin_stories_desc: Add and publish anonymized real-world immigration journeys for the public archive.
questionnaire_desc: Answer all sections honestly. Your answers generate a personalized recommendation.
results_export_pdf: Export PDF with checklist and recommendations
results_preparation_desc: You don't have a US job offer yet. Below are documents to prepare and steps to take before applying for a work visa.
results_no_match: No matching visa found. Consider consulting an immigration attorney.
dashboard_no_cases: No cases yet. Start the questionnaire to create your first case.
dashboard_delete_confirm_description: This will permanently remove the case and its progress. This action cannot be undone.
not_found_desc: The page you are looking for does not exist.
